problem_title: A finite uniform Smale mean-value constant for split cubics over C([0,1],C)

evidence.text:
Over the fixed connected algebra C([0,1],C), no finite constant controls the first-order Smale norm divided difference for all split monic cubics. For every proposed constant, a continuous cubic family has an invertible test derivative and exactly two existing critical elements, both violating the bound.
